8.
Where any person to whom this Part applies fails to
comply with the provisions of this Act, he shall be liable to
be dealt with in terms of the provisions of the respective law
specified in Schedule I or Schedule IV hereto.

9.
 For the avoidance of doubt it is hereby declared that
the provisions of this Part shall apply to any person to whom
this  Part  applies,  notwithstanding  anything  done  or  any
amnesty  granted  under  the  provisions  of  Inland  Revenue
